Package com.github.crittscott.somegoogly.client

Class GooglyTracker

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somegoogly.client.GooglyTracker
public class GooglyTracker extends Object
Per-entity client-side eye state: the GooglyTracker.EyeInfo pupil-physics simulator for every configured eye, plus which BehaviorInstance (if any) is currently playing on that entity.

One tracker is kept per tracked LivingEntity (see ClientEyeRuntime), matched against the entity's current placement via matches(com.github.crittscott.somegoogly.eye.HeadInfo). update() advances the active behavior and steps every eye's physics once per client tick; startBehavior(com.github.crittscott.somegoogly.eye.behavior.EyeBehavior, int, long, int) applies a server-triggered behavior, enforcing the "one at a time, non-interruptable" rule.

    Physics state for one pupil: its position and velocity in the eye's unit disk, the head orientation used to derive angular forcing, and the non-physical overlay values (grow/blink/tint) an active behavior writes each tick.

      public int lastRenderTick
      The client tick during which this tracker was last rendered. ClientEyeRuntime evicts the tracker once this goes stale and simulates it only while it is being rendered, so off-screen eyes freeze instead of wobbling unseen.

    • startBehavior

      public boolean startBehavior(@Nonnull EyeBehavior behavior, int duration, long seed, int elapsed)
      Start a behavior now, unless one is already playing — the "one at a time, non-interruptable" rule. Returns whether it started (a dropped trigger returns false). Called from the trigger packet on the client.

      elapsed starts the behavior that many ticks in, so a player who starts watching a mob mid-effect sees the same state as everyone else: the seeded onStart plus the age fully determine each behavior's influence.
